comment.text: ATP6V1B2 P352 is represented as a recurrently mutated residue in Cancer Hotspots v1. Source observations include Cancer Hotspots source tumor code: cscc; Cancer Hotspots source tumor code: nbl; Cutaneous melanoma. Statistical enrichment supports review as a candidate somatic hotspot; it does not establish the functional effect, pathogenicity, or treatment sensitivity of every alteration at this position. This site is present only in the historical V1 material in this collection.

report_comment.text: Somatic alterations affecting ATP6V1B2 residue P352 have been observed in cutaneous melanoma. The functional and clinical significance depend on the specific alteration and tumor type.
